phases.title: Phase 0 — Scaffold & Design Tokens

items.text: Confirm frontendv3 Shadcn Admin Dashboard base
Tailwind config tokens: custom (blue) + zink ramp
Public Sans font + named spacings (header, vertical-menu)
Sidebar shell + topbar + notification drawer wired to UI store

testsRequired: Theme toggle persists across reload
Layout renders without console errors
Responsive breakpoints don't break the shell
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 1 — Auth & Shell

items.text: Auth context + token storage (no plaintext token exposed)

testsRequired: Login success/failure states
Token refresh on 401
useCan() hides/shows a gated nav item for a mocked low-privilege role
Logout clears session state
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 2 — CRUD Foundation

items.text: First CRUD pages: Division, Department, Shifts, Employee Settings

testsRequired: DataTable sorting/pagination tests
Modal open/close/focus-trap tests
One full CRUD flow test: create, appears in table, edit, delete
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 3 — Org / Projects / RBAC

items.text: Subdivisions, Phase, Owner, Models, Model Types

testsRequired: RBAC editor: assigning a permission reflects in a mocked useCan() check
Subdivision Wizard multi-step state test: data isn't lost between steps
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 4A — Attendance/Leave read views

items.text: Confirm no client-side recomputation of rendered/late/undertime/OT anywhere

testsRequired: Test asserting DTR table renders backend-supplied numbers unmodified
Empty/loading/error states for each view
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 4B — Attendance/Leave approval actions
testsRequired: Approval action sends correct payload and reflects server's resulting state (not optimistic guess)
Permission guard test on approve/reject buttons for a low-privilege mocked user
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 5A — Payroll & gov-contribution config editors
testsRequired: Config editor form validation tests
Super-admin-only route guard test on the Sync page
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 5B — Payroll generation UI

items.text: Confirm preview shown in UI is the same API response used for generation

phases.note: Cross-project dependency: the f5b chain implicitly assumes the backend payroll phases (b4a / b4b / b4c) are complete first. The tracker does not enforce this automatically — it is a manual coordination point between the two rewrites.
testsRequired: Payslip renders all backend fields without client-side rounding/recalculation
Generation-trigger disabled state while request is in flight (prevents duplicate submission)
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 5C — Verification gate

items.text: Audit every payroll/config UI value traces to a single backend field
Confirm no derived/recalculated money math exists in the frontend

testsRequired: Automated check (lint rule or grep-based test) for arithmetic operators near currency-typed props/fields — hard gate before Phase 6
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 6 — Dashboard & Polish
testsRequired: KPI tiles render backend-supplied numbers unmodified
Keyboard navigation / focus-visible test
Automated a11y scan (e.g. axe) passes on core pages
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 7 — Cutover

items.text: Point API client at new FastAPI backend
Parity check key flows: login, generate payroll, file leave

testsRequired: End-to-end smoke test for login/generate-payroll/file-leave against the real new backend
Confirm no leftover calls to the old API base URL remain in the codebase
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete
